stories.title: Uefa to boycott World Cups if Fifa plans approved
stories.body: Uefa says "the World Cup is not for sale" after its 55 member associations vote to boycott future tournaments if Fifa and its president, Gianni Infantino, do not back down on their investment proposals.

stories.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
stories.body: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

stories.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
stories.body: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

stories.title: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
stories.body: The territory's leader said the influx is overwhelming resources and urged the Spanish government to intervene.

stories.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
stories.body: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

stories.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
stories.body: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

stories.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
stories.body: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

stories.title: Father of teen school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
stories.body: "It is clear you failed as a parent," the judge told Colin Gray, who was found guilty earlier this year on charges stemming from the deadly 2024 school attack.

stories.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
stories.body: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

stories.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
stories.body: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.

stories.title: Thousands evacuated in Crete as wildfires threaten tourist resorts
stories.body: Strong winds have fanned the flames in the Rethymno region as wildfires continue to ravage the Greek island.

stories.title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents
stories.body: It marks a change of tone for his administration, which has taken a more hands-off approach to the technology.

stories.title: Veteran Ugandan opposition leader collapses in court and in ICU, his wife says
stories.body: The 70 year old has been in detention since November 2024 and faces treason charges, which he denies.

stories.title: Australia takes Telegram to court over alleged failure to remove 'pro-terror' material
stories.body: Telegram told the BBC it rejects the allegations and will contest them in court.

stories.title: Singapore fines French teen $465 for viral straw-licking stunt
stories.body: The 19-year-old was "truly sorry" for causing trouble, his lawyers said.

stories.title: Worth $5m? Visitors react to renovated Washington horse statues
stories.body: The Trump Administration has regilded the Arts of War statues near the Lincoln Memorial with 23.75-karat gold.

stories.title: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct
stories.body: The actor and musician faces allegations from 10 women in total who say he mistreated them as teenagers.

stories.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offences
stories.body: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.

stories.title: Oscar-winning songwriter Glen Hansard killed in crash
stories.body: Hansard, who was 56, won the best song Oscar for the 2007 low-budget musical film Once.

stories.title: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
stories.body: People are being urged to stay alert, with earthquake aftershocks potentially reaching magnitude 7, officials say
